source.notes: Stainless spec from perplexityai/perplexity-node .stats.yml on branch next (updated 2026-07-17). Server https://api.perplexity.ai. Note chat is /chat/completions (no /v1) while responses is /v1/responses.

response_formatting_locale.title: Response Formatting Locale
response_formatting_locale.description: Optional locale tag used for response formatting conventions. Locale-style values such as `es_mx`, `EN-us`, and `zh-TW` are normalized to the canonical form (`es-MX`, `en-US`, `zh-TW`). Invalid values are ignored.

language_preference.description: ISO 639-1 language code for response language

max_steps.description:
Maximum number of research loop steps.
If provided, overrides the preset's max_steps value.
Must be >= 1 if specified. Maximum allowed is 100.

model.description:
Model ID in provider/model format (e.g., "xai/grok-4-1", "openai/gpt-4o").
If models is also provided, models takes precedence.
Required if neither models nor preset is provided.

models.description:
Model fallback chain. Each model is in provider/model format.
Models are tried in order until one succeeds.
Max 5 models allowed. If set, takes precedence over single model field.
The response.model will reflect the model that actually succeeded.

preset.description:
Preset configuration name (e.g., "sonar-pro", "sonar-reasoning").
Pre-configured model with system prompt and search parameters.
Required if model is not provided.

stream.description: If true, returns SSE stream instead of JSON

background.description: Run the response asynchronously. When true, the request is queued and the response object's `status` will be `queued` or `in_progress`. Poll GET /v1/responses/{response_id} to retrieve the final result.
background.title: Background

previous_response_id.description: OpenAI-compatible previous response id for multi-turn response chains. When set, the new response continues from the completed prior response using its durable continuation snapshot. The prior response must belong to the same account and have completed.

store.description: OpenAI-compatible storage toggle. When false, the response is hidden from later retrieve calls, and the echoed response reports `store: false`. It can still be used as a `previous_response_id` continuation source.

skills.description: Built-in and request-scoped inline skills available to the model. Skill metadata is disclosed to the model up front; full instructions are loaded on demand through the `load_skill` tool. Selecting any skill enables the sandbox tool for the request. Requests with skills run on the durable backend and skills are not echoed back on Response objects.

ResponsesResponse.description: Non-streaming response returned when stream is false

background.description: Whether the response was created in background mode.
background.title: Background

previous_response_id.title: Previous Response Id
previous_response_id.description: ID of the previous response in the chain, when the response was created with previous_response_id.

store.title: Store
store.description: Whether the response is stored and visible to later retrieve calls. A response created with store=false can still be used as a previous_response_id continuation source.

ResponsesResponse.title: ResponsesResponse

Input.description: Input content - either a string or array of input items
Input.title: Input

effort.description: How much effort the model should spend on reasoning

ResponseFormat.description: Specifies the desired output format for the model response
ResponseFormat.title: ResponseFormat

Skill.description: One skill made available to the model: a built-in selection from the catalog or a request-scoped inline skill.
Skill.title: Skill

OutputItem.title: OutputItem
OutputItem.description: One item in the response output: an assistant message, retrieved tool results, or a record of a tool call.

Status.description: Status of a response or output item
Status.title: Status

request_cost.title: Request Cost
request_cost.description: Flat request cost for the chat completion. Present on completed (terminal) responses and omitted from the zero cost skeleton on interim streaming chunks.

JSONSchemaFormat.description: Defines a JSON schema for structured output validation

name.description: Name of the schema (1-64 alphanumeric chars)

strict.description: Whether to enforce strict schema validation

JSONSchemaFormat.title: JSONSchemaFormat

search_context_size.title: Search Context Size
search_context_size.description: Search context size (low, medium, high). Omit when supplying explicit max_tokens / max_tokens_per_page.

max_urls.description: Maximum number of URLs to fetch per tool call

description.description: A description of what the function does

parameters.description: JSON Schema defining the function's parameters

strict.description: Whether to enable strict schema validation

type.description: Enables the `finance_search` tool. The model can request structured financial data (quotes, financials, segments, earnings transcripts, etc.) via category-based fan-out to FMP, Finchat, and Quartr.
Enables the `sandbox` tool. The model can execute code in an isolated container during the request and use the result in its final answer.

McpTool.description:
Connects a user-supplied remote MCP server. The worker discovers the
server's tools at boot and calls them like native tools. Matches
OpenAI's mcp tool. `require_approval`, `connector_id`, and
`defer_loading` are not supported in v1 and are ignored if sent:
every call auto-runs, and only bring-your-own `server_url` is honored.

allowed_tools.description: Optional allowlist of tool names. Empty exposes all discovered tools.

authorization.description: An OAuth access token that can be used with a remote MCP server, with a custom MCP server URL. Never logged or echoed.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Never logged or echoed.

server_label.description: Unique per request, ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$. Namespaces the server's tools.

server_url.description: HTTPS URL of the remote MCP server.

McpTool.title: McpTool

BuiltinSkill.description: Selects a built-in skill from the catalog by name.

name.description: Built-in skill to make available to the model. office is the full Office bundle (enables all four leaves). office/docx, office/pdf, office/pptx, office/xlsx each create polished documents of that type from scratch, with structural validation and visual QA.

BuiltinSkill.title: BuiltinSkill

InlineSkill.description: Request-scoped skill defined inline. Inline skills have no files or sandbox mounts and are never echoed back in the response.

description.description: Short discovery description, limited to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes.

instructions.description: Instructions returned by `load_skill`, limited to 65,536 UTF-8 bytes per skill and 262,144 bytes across the request.

name.description: Request-scoped lowercase ASCII name separated by single hyphens.

InlineSkill.title: InlineSkill

thought_signature.description: Base64-encoded opaque signature for thinking models

McpListToolsOutputItem.description: Tools discovered on one external MCP server at boot. Matches OpenAI's mcp_list_tools item.
McpListToolsOutputItem.title: McpListToolsOutputItem

McpCallOutputItem.description: One tool call executed against an external MCP server, modeled on OpenAI's mcp_call item.

error.description: The failure string when the call failed (also returned to the model in-band); null on success, matching OpenAI's mcp_call.

output.description: Tool output text; empty when the call failed.

McpCallOutputItem.title: McpCallOutputItem

SkillLoadedOutputItem.description: Per-call result emitted by the `load_skill` tool. Only the resolved skill name is surfaced here; the skill body itself lives in the function_call_output input item the model consumes on its next turn.

name.description: Name of the skill that was loaded.

SkillLoadedOutputItem.title: SkillLoadedOutputItem

arguments.description: Raw JSON arguments the executor passed to the advisor tool.

question.description: Parsed advisor question when present in arguments.

advice.description: Guidance returned by the advisor model.

error_code.description: Non-fatal advisor error code when the advisor call failed.

error_message.description: Non-fatal advisor error message when the advisor call failed.

AdvisorResultOutputItem.title: AdvisorResultOutputItem

SandboxResultsOutputItem.description:
Sandbox tool results emitted in `response.output[]`. Cost is aggregated
into `Usage.tool_calls_details.sandbox.cost_usd`; this item does not
carry per-execution cost.
SandboxResultsOutputItem.title: SandboxResultsOutputItem

SandboxWriteFileOutputItem.description: Per-invocation result of the `write` tool inside the sandbox.
SandboxWriteFileOutputItem.title: SandboxWriteFileOutputItem

SandboxReadFileOutputItem.description: Per-invocation result of the `read` tool inside the sandbox.
SandboxReadFileOutputItem.title: SandboxReadFileOutputItem

SandboxEditFileOutputItem.description: Per-invocation result of the `edit` tool inside the sandbox.
SandboxEditFileOutputItem.title: SandboxEditFileOutputItem

SandboxGrepOutputItem.description: Per-invocation result of the `grep` tool inside the sandbox.
SandboxGrepOutputItem.title: SandboxGrepOutputItem

SandboxGlobOutputItem.description: Per-invocation result of the `glob` tool inside the sandbox.
SandboxGlobOutputItem.title: SandboxGlobOutputItem

SandboxApplyPatchOutputItem.description: Per-invocation result of the `apply_patch` tool inside the sandbox.
SandboxApplyPatchOutputItem.title: SandboxApplyPatchOutputItem

ShareFileOutputItem.description: Result of one `share_file` tool call. On success, file_id and filename identify a sandbox file downloadable at url.
ShareFileOutputItem.title: ShareFileOutputItem

UnknownOutputItem.description: Forward-compat fallback for proto OutputItem variants the gateway does not yet have a typed schema for.
UnknownOutputItem.title: UnknownOutputItem

invocation.description: Number of times this tool was invoked

WebSearchStepDetails.title: WebSearchStepDetails
WebSearchStepDetails.description: Web search step details wrapper class

FetchUrlContentStepDetails.title: FetchUrlContentStepDetails
FetchUrlContentStepDetails.description: Fetch url content step details wrapper class

ExecutePythonStepDetails.title: ExecutePythonStepDetails
ExecutePythonStepDetails.description: Code generation step details wrapper class

call_id.description: The call_id that correlates with function_call_output

ToolUserLocation.description: User's geographic location for search personalization
ToolUserLocation.title: ToolUserLocation

SearchResult.description: A single search result used in LLM responses
SearchResult.title: SearchResult

url.description: The URL from which content was fetched

McpToolDef.description: One tool discovered on a remote MCP server.

input_schema.description: The server's JSON Schema for the tool, passed through unmodified.

McpToolDef.title: McpToolDef

SandboxResult.description:
One sandbox execution result. `status` describes whether the sandbox
runner completed, failed, or timed out. `exit_code` is the program exit
code, so `status: completed` can still have a non-zero `exit_code`.
SandboxResult.title: SandboxResult

InputContent.description: Message content - either a string or array of content parts
InputContent.title: InputContent
